notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
description:
Deal combat damage using Meneldor, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Meneldor's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Meneldor's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.
